pages.text: $(bold)Bendable, Not Breakable$(/bold)$(br2)The tier system is designed to be bent by skilled players, not broken. A shortcut that gets you one next-tier item early is a feature. A shortcut that skips an entire tier is a bug.$(br2)$(bold)Break$(/bold) = Create mixing produces diamonds in Tier 1.$(br)$(bold)Bend$(/bold) = Create mixing produces steel from iron+coal at a worse ratio than Thermal.

$(bold)Abundance, Not Scarcity$(/bold)$(br2)There are no resource locks. Crops, building mods, QoL features, and travel are available from day one. What is gated is $(italic)power$(/italic) — weapons, armor, magic systems, and dimensions.$(br2)You should never feel blocked from having fun. You may feel blocked from the next tier of power. That is intentional.

$(bold)Death Is a Cost$(/bold)$(br2)Keep inventory is on. You will never lose your items on death. However, your equipped gear loses durability — and at zero durability, items go $(italic)inert$(/italic): they stop working but remain in your inventory.$(br2)Dying in Tier 1 is cheap. Dying in the End with Tier 4 gear is genuinely expensive. Soulbound enchantment is the ultimate insurance.$(br2)See $(l:icraft:systems/death_penalty)Death Penalty$(/l) for full details.

$(bold)Boss Fights Are the Pinnacle$(/bold)$(br2)The best weapons in the pack — Simply Swords unique weapons — drop only from bosses. They cannot be crafted. They cannot be traded for. Each is thematically matched to its source boss.$(br2)This means engaging with the combat system isn't just fun — it's the only path to the best gear. Tier skipping via crafting will never give you what a boss kill will.
